mentions.name: Interactive DSP Learning Site
mentions.description: An interactive digital signal processing learning site with hands-on examples, including a mod tracker, an acoustic modem, a playable synth with MIDI keyboard support, a tool to measure the Shannon capacity of a room, and demos of psychoacoustic effects like masking.
mentions.source_excerpt: The DSP site was quite fun, there are lots of interesting interactive examples there like a mod tracker, an acoustic modem, a synth you can play with a midi keyboard, the ability to measure the Shannon capacity of your room, demos of psychoacoustic effects like masking ..
